text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
C.B.-chan, happy birthday! Your present is 
m-e♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...a drive with you,' is what I'd like to 
say, but you'd rather feel the wind on 
your own legs, wouldn't you, CB-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Hehe... So, what are you going to 
give me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Like you don't already know~! Come run 
alongside me and let's go feel the wind♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Yep, it's just as wonderful of a 
present as I expected!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, the truth is that you want to run 
too, don't you? I wonder if you can really 
call that a present.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's between me and myself. No peeking 
into a maiden's heart, silly!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Aha, you're right, sorry. That was 
tactless of me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
See you on the grounds, then. I'll be 
waiting, trusting that you'll give me the 
best present ever, okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Feel free to get your hopes up as high 
as you want. Be prepared, C.B.âª
